sanskrit: arundhatyaḥ saṃ vadante gāvaḥ pravrājinīr iva | yam āturam abhigaccha- -amāvataṃ kṛṇu māvatam ||
english: The Arundhati-plants speak together like cows going out to graze. Go to this afflicted one; make him free of ailment, free of ailment.

sanskrit: imaṃ me tvaṃ jarāmṛtyuṃ puruṣaṃ kṛṇv oṣadhe | rājñī hi sarvāsām asy oṣadhīnām arundhatī ||
english: Do thou, O herb, make this man of mine one who dies only of old age. For thou art Arundhati, queen of all herbs.

sanskrit: trāyamāṇā hy asi jīvalā vīryāvatī | arundhati tvām āhārṣam ito mā pārayān iti ||
english: For thou art Trāyamāṇā, life-giving, full of potency. O Arundhati, I have brought thee hither — 'from this one deliver him,' so I say.

sanskrit: digdhena ca viddhasya- -aghasyāghaviṣā ca yā | arundhati tvaṃ tasyāsi viṣasya viṣadūṣaṇī ||
english: For one pierced by a poisoned weapon, and for the evil and its evil venom — O Arundhati, thou art the poison-destroyer of that poison.

sanskrit: āheyena ca daṣṭasya- -aghasya (…) ||
english: For one bitten by a snake and by that evil — [Arundhati, thou art the poison-destroyer of that poison].

sanskrit: vātīkāreṇa ca kṣiptasya- -aghasya (…) ||
english: For one struck down by a wind-demon and by that evil — [Arundhati, thou art the poison-destroyer of that poison].

sanskrit: bhavena ca (…) | (…) ||
english: And by Bhava — [for one struck down by that evil, Arundhati, thou art the poison-destroyer of that poison].

sanskrit: śarveṇa ca (…) | (…) ||
english: And by Śarva — [for one struck down by that evil, Arundhati, thou art the poison-destroyer of that poison].

sanskrit: rudreṇa ca (…) | (…) ||
english: And by Rudra — [for one struck down by that evil, Arundhati, thou art the poison-destroyer of that poison].

sanskrit: paśupatinā ca kṣiptasya (…) ||
english: And for one struck down by Paśupati — [that evil, Arundhati, thou art the poison-destroyer of that poison].

sanskrit: ugreṇa ca devena ca kṣiptasya (…) ||
english: And for one struck down by the fierce deity Ugra — [that evil, Arundhati, thou art the poison-destroyer of that poison].

sanskrit: mahādevena ca kṣiptasya (…) ||
english: And for one struck down by Mahādeva — [that evil, Arundhati, thou art the poison-destroyer of that poison].

sanskrit: īśānena ca kṣiptasya- -aghasyāghaviṣā ca yā | arundhati (…) ||
english: And for one struck down by Īśāna, and for the evil and its evil venom — O Arundhati, [thou art the poison-destroyer of that poison].

sanskrit: yat pṛthivyāṃ viṣaṃ vīrutsv adhi yad viṣam | (…) ||
english: Whatever poison is in the earth, whatever poison is upon the plants — [Arundhati, thou art the poison-destroyer of that poison].

sanskrit: yad oṣadhībhyaḥ saṃbharanti brahmāṇo menaye viṣam | (…) ||
english: Whatever poison brahmins collect from herbs for a woman — [Arundhati, thou art the poison-destroyer of that poison].

sanskrit: yad brāhmaṇāḥ saṃbharanti tṛṣṭamāśīviṣaṃ viṣam | (…) ||
english: Whatever sharp, keenly-virulent poison brahmins compound — [Arundhati, thou art the poison-destroyer of that poison].

sanskrit: yaḥ kṣipto mṛtyunā yasmair yo daṣṭas tṛṣṭadaṃśmabhiḥ | arundhati tvaṃ tasyāsi viṣasya viṣadūṣaṇī ||
english: He who has been struck down by death, by those through whom he is struck, he who has been bitten by sharp-fanged creatures — O Arundhati, thou art the poison-destroyer of that poison.

sanskrit: saṃ jihīṣvāmukthā yakṣmād ārukṣo lokam uttamam | apā jīvasi pātreṇa- -adhi jīvapurā ihi ||
english: Rouse thyself, rise up free of disease! Ascend to the highest realm. Thou dost live by a vessel of water — come hither to the city of the living.

sanskrit: apsaraso vi vo yakṛd vi vo bhinadmi mehanam | vi caṇḍālaṃ vy arjunaṃ vi vavṛtraṃ bhinadmi vaḥ ||
english: O Apsarases, I split asunder your liver, I split asunder your urinary organ; the Caṇḍāla, the Arjuna, and the Vavṛtra — these of yours I split asunder.

sanskrit: viśvajanyāḥ pāñcajanyā mahārukmāḥ śikhaṇḍinīḥ | sarvā indrasya vajreṇa hatā budbudayātavaḥ ||
english: The universal-folk Apsarases, the five-tribal, the great-golden-ornament, the crest-bearing — all those bubble-roaming spirits have been slain by Indra's thunderbolt.

sanskrit: andhācīm asitācīm ulūkhalasya budhnena | avaitaṃ vatsapaṃ jahi ||
english: With the base of the mortar, smite the blind-one, the dark-one — drive them away; strike down the calf-drinker.

sanskrit: dūrād enāḥ praty ā paśyam āpatantīr atho divaḥ | devānāṃ havyamohanīr indro apsaraso hanat ||
english: From afar I saw these ones flying toward me, and from the sky too — those who bewitch the oblations of the gods; Indra smote the Apsarases.

sanskrit: ā hatā apa tā itaḥ khalād iva yātudhānyaḥ | amuṃ gacchata pūruṣaṃ samudram apa gacchati ||
english: Struck down, away with them from here — like female sorcerers driven from a threshing floor! Go to that man over there; away she goes to the ocean.

sanskrit: divaṃ gacchantu divyāḥ saro gacchantu sārasīḥ | uluṅgulasya yo guhas tad u gacchantv āsurīḥ ||
english: Let the celestial ones go to the sky; let the lake-dwellers go to the lake; whatever hiding-place belongs to Uluṅgula, to that very place let the Āsurī spirits go.

sanskrit: āskandike viskandike parācīr apa nṛtyantu | sāraṅgeṇa śunā saha ||
english: O Āskandikas, O Viskandikas, dance away in the direction of the far distance — together with the spotted dog.

sanskrit: yaḥ sāraṅgo hiraṇyadan śvā divyaḥ pariplavaḥ | tasyāhaṃ nāma jagrabha- -asmā ariṣṭatātaye ||
english: The spotted one, the golden-giving, the celestial dog who roams everywhere — his name have I seized, for the sake of uninjured wholeness for this man.

sanskrit: adyāṃ te viraṇī parācīr apa nṛtyata | śṛṇāmi ghorā vaḥ pṛṣṭī brahmaṇā kīkasā uta ||
english: Today, O Viraṇī, dance away in the direction of the far distance! I shall crush your dreadful backbones and your vertebrae too with sacred power.

sanskrit: ekatriṃśad aśvavatīś catasra uta guṅguvaḥ | śivā daśa śṛtā daśa keśinīḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ | idam uluṅgulukābhyo apsarābhyo 'karaṃ namaḥ ||
english: Thirty-one horse-possessing ones, four Guṅguvas as well; ten propitious ones, ten Śṛtās, twenty-five long-haired ones — to these Uluṅgulukā Apsarases I have made obeisance.
